title: Snorkelling at Mnemba Atoll
excerpt: Mnemba Atoll is the best-known snorkelling spot on Zanzibar, with coral, colourful fish and often turtles and dolphins.
body:
Mnemba Atoll lies off the northeast coast of Zanzibar. The reef around the atoll is a marine conservation area.

## What you see

Coral gardens, tropical fish, starfish, sometimes green turtles and, on the way, dolphins.

## How it works

Boats leave from the northeast coast, such as Matemwe, or from Nungwi. Snorkelling sessions take place in the shallow water around the atoll. The island itself is private and cannot be visited.

## Responsible snorkelling

- Do not touch or stand on the coral.
- Use reef-friendly sunscreen.
- Keep distance from turtles.
- Choose operators that respect the conservation rules.

## When

Best in calm seas. Visibility varies.

## Diving

Mnemba is also a good place for diving. See [diving in Tanzania](/blog/diving-in-tanzania/).

Read our [Mnemba page](/islands/mnemba-island/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
